Panels B and C: this replication; stars from the White standard errors; in panel C, p-values with standard errors clustered by country in brackets. The replication comes close to the published sample (3,113 against 3,141 observations with GE) and within R², and reproduces the signs and significance of the full-period estimates, but its interaction coefficients are 2.5 to 2.9 times the published ones; without the authors' code the difference cannot be traced (later vintages of the WDI series are one candidate). Panel C changes only the measure of government consumption (log of consumption over trend GDP, Hamilton filter; or consumption lagged one year) on the same country-years. The analysis was added after the registered plan, when the published text became available, and is exploratory. * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01.\end{minipage}
